description: This file defines the ManufacturerDescription entity class, which models the description details for a manufacturer in an e-commerce application. It includes attributes such as URL, URL clicks, last click date, and a reference to the Manufacturer entity.

classes.name: ManufacturerDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing a localized description for a manufacturer, including URL, click statistics, and a reference to the Manufacturer entity.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: getUrlClicked
methods.description: Returns the number of times the URL has been clicked.

methods.name: setUrlClicked
methods.description: Sets the number of times the URL has been clicked.

methods.name: getDateLastClick
methods.description: Returns the date of the last click on the URL.

methods.name: setDateLastClick
methods.description: Sets the date of the last URL click.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer entity associated with this description.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer entity with this description.
